filler_lines: इस टॉपिक के पूरे नोट्स चाहिए? नोट्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, नोट्स ज़रूर ले लीजिए।
प्रैक्टिस के लिए मॉक टेस्ट चाहिए? मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, मॉक्स ज़रूर ले लीजिए।
नोट्स और मॉक्स, दोनों के लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में मौजूद हैं, उन्हें लेना मत भूलिए।
रिवीज़न के लिए नोट्स लीजिए, और परीक्षा जैसी प्रैक्टिस के लिए मॉक्स लीजिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
जो प्रश्न अभी छूट गए, उनके नोट्स डिस्क्रिप्शन में दिए लिंक से ले लीजिए।
हर हफ्ते मॉक टेस्ट हल करने से स्कोर बढ़ता है, मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
अगर अब तक के प्रश्न सही रहे, तो मॉक्स लेकर अपना स्तर और परखिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
नोट्स लेना न भूलें, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, और अपने दोस्तों को भी बताइए।
कंप्यूटर के प्रश्नों पर पकड़ मज़बूत करनी है? तो नोट्स लीजिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
वीडियो पसंद आ रहा है तो लाइक कीजिए, और नोट्स व मॉक्स के लिए डिस्क्रिप्शन का लिंक खोलिए।
मॉक टेस्ट हल करने की आदत डालिए, मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, अभी ले लीजिए।
चैनल Target1st को सब्सक्राइब कीजिए, नोट्स और मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
ये पॉइंट नोट कर लीजिए, और पूरे नोट्स के लिए डिस्क्रिप्शन में दिया लिंक देखिए।
सिर्फ़ वीडियो देखना काफ़ी नहीं, मॉक्स भी हल कीजिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
नोट्स ले लो, मॉक्स ले लो, दोनों के लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में हैं, और तैयारी में जुट जाओ।

questions.q: Which part is known as the brain of the computer?
points: CPU means Central Processing Unit
It executes instructions and controls other parts
Main parts: ALU, control unit and registers

questions.q: Which of the following is an input device?
points: Input devices send data into the computer
Keyboard, mouse, scanner and mic are input devices
Printer, monitor and speaker are output devices

questions.q: Which shortcut key copies the selected item in Windows?
points: Ctrl + C copies the selected item
Ctrl + X cuts and Ctrl + V pastes
Ctrl + Z undoes the last action

questions.q: The main screen that appears after Windows starts is called?
points: Desktop holds icons, shortcuts and the taskbar
Taskbar is the bar at the bottom of the screen
Recycle Bin keeps deleted files temporarily

questions.q: What is the full form of RAM?
points: RAM is the main working memory of the computer
It is volatile, so data is lost when power is off
Its contents can be read and written quickly

questions.q: Which of the following is an operating system?
points: An OS manages hardware and software resources
Linux, Android and macOS are also operating systems
Chrome is a browser, Excel and Notepad are applications

questions.q: The speed of a CPU is measured in?
points: Clock speed shows cycles per second
1 GHz equals one billion cycles per second
GB measures storage, pixel and DPI measure display and print

questions.q: A network covering a small area like one building is called?
points: LAN means Local Area Network
WAN covers large areas, the Internet is the biggest WAN
MAN covers a city

questions.q: Which shortcut opens Task Manager directly in Windows?
points: Ctrl + Shift + Esc opens Task Manager at once
Alt + F4 closes the active window
Win + D shows or hides the desktop

questions.q: One byte is equal to how many bits?
points: 1 byte = 8 bits
1 KB = 1024 bytes
4 bits make one nibble

questions.q: Which device forwards data packets between different networks?
points: Router works at the Network layer
It uses IP addresses to choose the path
It connects a LAN to the Internet

questions.q: What is the default file extension of a Notepad file?
points: Notepad saves plain text only
Plain text has no formatting or images
.doc and .docx belong to MS Word

questions.q: Which of the following is a secondary storage device?
points: Secondary storage is non-volatile and permanent
Examples: hard disk, SSD, pen drive, DVD
RAM, cache and registers are primary memory

questions.q: Which topology connects all devices to a central switch or hub?
points: In a star, every node connects to one central device
Failure of one cable affects only that node
Failure of the central device stops the whole network

questions.q: What happens when you press Shift + Delete on a file in Windows?
options: It goes to the Recycle Bin
points: Shift + Delete skips the Recycle Bin
Such a file cannot be restored normally
Plain Delete sends the file to the Recycle Bin

questions.q: Which number system does a computer use internally?
points: Computers understand only 0 and 1
Binary has base 2
Hexadecimal has base 16 and octal has base 8

questions.q: Which protocol assigns IP addresses to devices automatically?
points: DHCP means Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol
It gives IP, subnet mask and gateway automatically
DNS converts domain names into IP addresses

questions.q: An IPv4 address is how many bits long?
points: IPv4 uses 32 bits in four octets
Each octet ranges from 0 to 255
IPv6 uses 128 bits

questions.q: Which shortcut locks a Windows computer?
points: Win + L locks the screen at once
Win + E opens File Explorer
Win + R opens the Run box

questions.q: Which device converts digital signals to analog and back for phone-line internet?
points: Modem = Modulator + Demodulator
It converts digital data to analog and back
It connects a computer to the ISP

questions.q: Which of these is the fastest memory in a computer?
points: Speed order: register > cache > RAM > disk
Registers sit inside the CPU
Cache sits between CPU and RAM

questions.q: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for routing?
points: Network layer is Layer 3
It uses logical IP addresses
Routers work at this layer

questions.q: What is the maximum length of a file name in Windows NTFS?
points: NTFS allows file names up to 255 characters
The old DOS 8.3 format allowed only 8 characters
Characters like \ / : * ? are not allowed

questions.q: Which is the default file system of modern Windows?
points: NTFS supports security, encryption and large files
FAT32 cannot store a single file above 4 GB
ext4 is used by Linux, HFS+ by older macOS

questions.q: Which command displays the IP configuration in Command Prompt?
points: ipconfig shows IP, subnet mask and gateway
ipconfig /all gives full adapter details
ping tests connectivity and tracert shows the path

questions.q: What is the full form of WWW?
points: WWW was invented by Tim Berners-Lee
Web pages are viewed through a browser
Internet is the network, the Web is a service on it

questions.q: Which of the following is a web browser?
points: A browser is used to open and view web pages
Chrome, Edge, Safari and Opera are browsers
Bing is a search engine and Gmail is an email service

questions.q: Which HTML tag creates the largest heading?
points: HTML has six heading levels, h1 to h6
h1 is the largest and h6 is the smallest
<head> and <title> are not headings

questions.q: Which shortcut saves a document in MS Word?
points: Ctrl + S saves the document
Ctrl + O opens and Ctrl + N creates a new one
Ctrl + P opens the print window

questions.q: What is the full form of HTML?
points: HTML defines the structure of a web page
It is a markup language, not a programming language
Tim Berners-Lee created it

questions.q: Which symbol normally starts a formula in MS Excel?
points: A formula normally begins with the equals sign
Example: =A1+B1
Without = the entry is treated as plain text

questions.q: What is the full form of URL?
points: URL is the address of a web page
It has protocol, domain name and path
Example: https://www.example.com/page

questions.q: Which HTML tag inserts a line break?
points: is an empty tag with no closing tag
It moves the text to the next line
<hr> draws a horizontal line

questions.q: Which Excel function adds a range of cells?
points: SUM adds all numbers in a range
Example: =SUM(A1:A10)
AutoSum button is on the Home tab

questions.q: Which protocol is used to send email?
points: SMTP means Simple Mail Transfer Protocol
POP3 and IMAP are used to receive email
SMTP commonly uses port 25

questions.q: Which HTML tag creates a hyperlink?
points: <a> is the anchor tag
The href attribute holds the destination address
<link> is used in the head for stylesheets

questions.q: Which Word tab has Margins and Orientation options?
points: Margins, Orientation and Size are in the Layout tab
Older Word versions call it Page Layout
Review tab has spelling and comments

questions.q: Which attribute of the tag gives alternate text?
points: alt text shows if the image fails to load
It also helps screen readers
src gives the image path

questions.q: Which Excel function counts cells that contain numbers?
points: COUNT counts only numeric cells
COUNTA counts all non-empty cells
COUNTIF counts cells that meet a condition

questions.q: What does HTTPS add over HTTP?
points: HTTPS uses SSL/TLS encryption
Its default port is 443, HTTP uses 80
A padlock in the address bar shows a secure site

questions.q: Which key starts a slide show from the first slide in PowerPoint?
points: F5 starts the show from the beginning
Shift + F5 starts from the current slide
Esc ends the slide show

questions.q: Which HTML tag creates a bulleted (unordered) list?
points: <ul> makes an unordered list
<ol> makes a numbered list
<li> defines each list item

questions.q: Which of the following is an absolute cell reference in Excel?
points: Dollar signs lock both column and row
It does not change when the formula is copied
F4 key toggles reference types

questions.q: What is the full form of DHTML?
points: DHTML combines HTML, CSS, JavaScript and DOM
It makes web pages interactive and animated
It is a technique, not a separate language

questions.q: Which CSS property changes the colour of text?
points: Example: p { color: red; }
background-color changes the background
font-size changes the text size

questions.q: Which Excel function searches the first column and returns a value from another column?
points: VLOOKUP looks vertically down the first column
HLOOKUP searches across the first row
Last argument FALSE (or 0) gives exact match

questions.q: Which HTML tag defines a table row?
points: <tr> means table row
<td> is a data cell and <th> a header cell
<table> wraps the whole table

questions.q: Which HTTP status code means Page Not Found?
points: 404 means the requested page was not found
200 means OK and 301 means moved permanently
500 means internal server error

questions.q: Mail Merge in MS Word is used to?
options: Create personalised letters for many people
points: It joins a main document with a data source
Fields like Name and Address are filled automatically
Find it in the Mailings tab

questions.q: In DHTML, which model lets scripts access and change page elements?
points: DOM means Document Object Model
It shows the page as a tree of objects
JavaScript uses it to change content and style
